dog.description_text:
Meet Lavender! This sweet, 1-year-old girl recently joined the Every Last One Rescue family.

Lavender is an affectionate, enthusiastic pup with a serious zest for life! She absolutely LOVES other dogs and is always excited to say hello to everyone she meets. She's a social butterfly who never misses an opportunity to make a new friend!

This happy girl loves neighborhood walks, sniffing adventures, and puzzle toys that keep her curious mind busy. She's equally enthusiastic about getting pets, giving hugs, and soaking up all the love and attention she can get.

Lavender is full of puppy charm, affection, and personality, and we can't wait to see more of her shine as she settles into foster care.

Check back soon for more updates on this lovely little lady!
dog.name: Lavender
